title: Clap
desc: An ambitious athlete gets his dreams shattered following a devastating injury. Later, he coaches a young talent and fights against corrupt officials.

title: Saradara
desc: An orphaned guy finds a new lease on life in a village where everyone treats him like family. However, all hell breaks loose after he falls in love with the headman's daughter.

title: Grama Devathe
desc: Angala Parameswari, an avatar of Goddess Parvati, wants to protect the people of Earth. Kaveri, her ardent follower, seeks her help when her life is in danger.

title: Virupaksha
desc: While the occurrence of a series of mysterious deaths haunt the villagers, a man decides to risk his life and unravel the secret behind them.

title: Salaar
desc: Just when the prince of Khansaar is about to rise to the throne, a plan of overthrowing him is exercised and only one man can help him retrieve power.
